authority.scope: Validate GTK2 controls and the Theme Lab controller in isolated private Xvfb/bwrap fixtures; no user-session installation.

tests.scope: Real Motif controller with generated native GTK2 push control; Apply propagated to coupled and detached previews; detached close retained coupled preview; stale detached IPC rejected; reopen passed.
Native GTK2 toggle click and selection pixels; both origins remained clickable after Apply and controller restart.
Native GTK2 check click and indicator pixel; selection and both origins persisted through Apply/restart.
Native grouped GTK2 radio selection and indicator pixels; member state persisted through Apply/restart in both origins.

Broad controller workflow for GTK2 combo: initial coupled/detached previews, Apply, close, Undo reopen and Redo close passed; a subsequent reopen launched preview_gtk2.py, which terminated with an X Window System error before native separate metrics returned.

regression.failure_point: Reopening the detached native GTK2 preview after the close -> project Undo -> reopen -> project Redo -> close sequence.
regression.diagnosis: Not yet isolated between controller child-process lifecycle and native GTK2 preview teardown/reopen. The failing attempt does not invalidate successful initial open/Apply/close evidence, but prevents declaring repeated lifecycle verified.

limits: Generated control pixel checks prove the current recipe's expected rendering, not historical equivalence to Domain/OS.
The GTK2 recipe and full embedded-control coverage remain partial.
Historical held-state comparison for left, right and up still awaits the guest pointer visibly positioned on each target in the canonical VM.
User visual review remains open; no user-session theme was installed.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: Adds native-controller verification for GTK2 push/toggle/check/radio controls in coupled and detached origins. The repeated detached GTK2 reopen failure is recorded as unresolved, so no estimate increase is assigned. This is not a visual-fidelity score.
